_comment: Zero-record variant of datastore_sql.json — same UPSTREAM shape, empty records list. Exists for the confabulation guards: an empty result is the case where a server is most tempted to explain itself, and where a model is most tempted to invent. Structure is kept byte-identical to the populated fixture so the tests isolate emptiness, nothing else. See termdat-mcp#11 and mcp-audit check FID-003.
